score_method.name: Capability evidence index
score_method.description: Percentage quality metrics only. Lower-is-better percentages are inverted. Measurements are averaged by benchmark, then capability, then equally across capabilities with evidence.

target_policy.name: OpenEuroLLM post-training program floors
target_policy.description: Every registered evaluation has a direction-aware minimum release target for a competitive 9B–30B checkpoint. Targets are planning floors, not claims of state of the art, and must be interpreted under the pinned benchmark protocol.
target_policy.gap_definition: Positive means the model is beyond the target; negative means it is short of the target. Missing evidence has no gap and never passes.

capabilities.name: Coding
capabilities.question: Can the model write correct code and repair defects without losing general capabilities?

capabilities.name: Efficiency & Release
capabilities.question: Is the release complete, reproducible, fast enough, and robust after quantization?

capabilities.name: Grounding & RAG
capabilities.question: Can the model answer from supplied evidence, cite it, and say when evidence is insufficient?

capabilities.name: Instruction & Chat
capabilities.question: Does the model follow explicit, compositional, and conversational instructions in target languages?

capabilities.name: Long Context
capabilities.question: Does the checkpoint retain, retrieve, and reason over 128K and experimental 256K contexts?

capabilities.name: Multilingual
capabilities.question: Is the model useful across all 36 project languages, including the weakest language tier?

capabilities.name: Reasoning & Knowledge
capabilities.question: Can the model solve math, scientific, factual, and domain questions while retaining knowledge?

capabilities.name: Safety
capabilities.question: Does the model avoid harmful assistance without refusing benign requests, including in multi-turn European-language interaction?

capabilities.name: Tools & Agents
capabilities.question: Can the model select tools, emit valid calls, use results, and complete multi-step tasks?
